description: The plot illustrates "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" by comparing three different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 63.7 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to 69.8 at 0.2, experiences a drop to 67.2 at 0.7, reaches a peak of 75.1 at 0.8, and ends at 73.4 at 1.0. The "LUFFY" method is depicted by a solid dark red line with star markers, beginning at 76.1 at 0.1, rising to 78.8 at 0.2, maintaining a steady 76.1 across 0.3 and 0.4, and reaching its highest values of 80.5 at both 0.8 and 1.0, with a dip to 78.8 at 0.9. The "SFT" method is shown as a solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, starting at a peak of 76.1 at 0.1, declining to a low of 69.9 at 0.5, spiking back to 76.1 at 0.6, and fluctuating before ending at 74.3 at a temperature of 1.0.
